anchoredLines.line: Something pads into the clearing — the absence of sound, shaped like wings. It's here.

◈ THE WAR PATH — Footage plays. The galaxy has already watched these fights twice. The System narrates anyway — it likes the sound of its own broadcast voice. THE HERALD came. Named, not yet located. Even now the wave-4 bar reads: put weapons in hands (4 of 5 armed); blood your fighters (0 of 1 veterans). Even now the wave-5 bar reads: armor the village (2 of 4 fighters armored); put weapons in hands (4 of 6 armed); blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).
